title: Endeavour Silver | A New Chapter Begins: Terronera Mine Enters Commercial Production
summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. is a mid-tier precious metals mining company listed on the NYSE:EXK and TSX:EDR.
body_text: We are proud to announce a major milestone in Endeavour Silver’s journey, the Terronera Mine, located in Jalisco, Mexico, is now in commercial production. This moment marks not only a significant achievement for our company, but a powerful step forward for sustainable mining development in Mexico. Terronera, now Endeavour Silver’s flagship operation with the potential to significantly boost silver production both for Endeavour Silver and for Mexico. More than a project, Terronera represents the future of responsible mining and our next step toward becoming a senior silver producer. A Milestone Worth Celebrating Reaching commercial production is the result of years of vision, planning, and collective effort. Since 2010, our teams have worked tirelessly to transform Terronera from a promising exploration project into a fully operating mine. From early exploration to construction and now full-scale operations, the path to this point has been defined by collaboration with local communities, regional partners, and our incredible team. We celebrate this milestone not only as a technical and economic achievement, but as a testament to our focus on integrity, investing in long-term growth, and delivering shareholder value. Empowering Local Communities Terronera has been developed with a strong emphasis on community engagement and regional development. As production ramps up, so does our ability to contribute directly to the local economy through: Job creation and training programs Support for local suppliers and businesses Investment in infrastructure and community development initiatives Environmental stewardship and sustainable practices We believe mining can and should be a force for good, and our work in Jalisco is guided by that belief. See more of our community initiatives in our Terronera Blog Page . Analyst Tour As part of celebrating Terronera’s successful transition into commercial production, we recently welcomed a group of analysts for a site tour. It was an opportunity to showcase the progress, innovation, and teamwork behind Terronera’s development. We extend our appreciation to everyone who joined us on the visit, and a special thanks to our on-site team for their continued hard work and dedication in bringing this milestone project to life. Shaping the Future of Silver Mining With Terronera now operational, we are entering a new era for Endeavour Silver. One where we are positioned to be a key contributor to Mexico’s silver output and an industry leader. This mine strengthens our portfolio, enhances our production capacity, and furthers our mission to build a profitable and sustainable silver company that delivers long-term value for all stakeholders, from investors and employees to the communities where we operate. Looking Ahead Terronera is only the beginning of the next chapter. We will continue to apply our values of excellence, safety, transparency, and sustainability as we operate and grow. We are deeply grateful to our team, our partners, and the local community for bringing this vision to life. Watch the Completion Video Welcome to the new era of Endeavour Silver. Welcome to Terronera.

title: NVR, INC. ANNOUNCES SECOND QUARTER RESULTS
summary: RESTON, VA, July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NVR, Inc. For the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, net
body_text: RESTON, VA , July 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- NVR, Inc. (NYSE: NVR) , one of the nation's largest homebuilding and mortgage banking companies, announced net income for its second quarter ended June 30, 2026 of $236.5 million, or $83.96 per diluted share. For the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, net income and diluted earnings per share decreased 29% and 23%, respectively, when compared to 2025 second quarter net income of $333.7 million, or $108.54 per diluted share. Consolidated revenues for the second quarter of 2026 totaled $2.33 billion, compared to $2.60 billion in the second quarter of 2025. For the six months ended June 30, 2026, consolidated revenues were $4.21 billion, a 16% decrease from $5.00 billion reported for the same period of 2025. Net income for the six months ended June 30, 2026 was $434.8 million, a decrease of 31% when compared to net income for the six months ended June 30, 2025 of $633.3 million. Diluted earnings per share for the six months ended June 30, 2026 was $151.38, a decrease of 26% from $203.20 per diluted share for the same period of 2025. Homebuilding New orders in the second quarter of 2026 increased by 9% to 5,885 units, when compared to 5,379 units in the second quarter of 2025. The average sales price of new orders in the second quarter of 2026 was $437,100, a decrease of 5% when compared to the second quarter of 2025. The cancellation rate in the second quarter of 2026 was 15% compared to 17% in the second quarter of 2025. Settlements in the second quarter of 2026 decreased by 8% to 5,058 units, compared to 5,475 units in the second quarter of 2025. The average settlement price in the second quarter of 2026 was $450,700, a decrease of 3% when compared to the second quarter of 2025. Our backlog of homes sold but not settled as of June 30, 2026 increased on a unit basis by 9% to 10,998 units and increased on a dollar basis by 5% to $4.99 billion when compared to the respective backlog unit and dollar balances as of June 30, 2025. Homebuilding revenues of $2.28 billion in the second quarter of 2026 decreased by 11% compared to homebuilding revenues of $2.55 billion in the second quarter of 2025. Gross profit margin in the second quarter of 2026 decreased to 19.2%, from 21.5% in the second quarter of 2025. Gross profit margin was negatively impacted by higher lot costs, pricing pressure due to continued affordability challenges and weak consumer sentiment, and by contract land deposit impairments totaling approximately $21.7 million. Income before tax from the homebuilding segment totaled $293.2 million in the second quarter of 2026, a decrease of 30% when compared to the second quarter of 2025. Mortgage Banking Mortgage closed loan production in the second quarter of 2026 totaled $1.35 billion, a decrease of 13% when compared to the second quarter of 2025. Income before tax from the mortgage banking segment totaled $25.4 million in the second quarter of 2026, a decrease of 14% when compared to $29.6 million in the second quarter of 2025. About NVR NVR, Inc. operates in two business segments: homebuilding and mortgage banking. The homebuilding segment sells and builds homes under the Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes trade names, and operates in thirty-seven metropolitan areas in sixteen states and Washington, D.C. For more information about NVR, Inc. and its brands, see www.nvrinc.com , www.ryanhomes.com , www.nvhomes.com and www.heartlandluxuryhomes.com . title: Vertiv and Green Mountain Raise the Bar for Data Centre Sustainability
summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions, and Norwegian colocation provider Green Mountain have deployed cutting-edge technologies to further increase efficiency and sustainability at what was already among the greenest data centres in the world.
body_text: READ MORE Green Mountain’s Sustainability Enabled by Liebert® Cooling and Power For a colocation data centre that is carved out of a Norwegian mountain and running entirely on hydropower from a neighboring fjord, implementing the best in energy efficient thermal management was necessary for continued sustainability while scaling up existing capacity.
